overview: You wrote the second leaf. No name, no number, no person. You dated it the last of January, 1594. It is not the letter, and it is not a third page. You stopped.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the second leaf and stopped.

key_provisions.text: a page that is not a letter

assets.name: the inkhorn
assets.disposition: Wrote a second leaf and dated it the last of January
